nixEscaping.rule: Inside Nix indented strings (''...'' ), use ''${...} for literal bash variable references

examples.note: Without '' prefix, Nix tries to interpolate
Nix variables DO NOT need '' prefix

moduleConfig.description: All module options go under systemConfig prefix
mergingOrder: template-config.nix (base defaults, always loaded if exists)

passwordManagement.applyMethod: chpasswd -e (reads from stdin, expects pre-hashed password)

prebuildChecks.description: Run BEFORE nixos-rebuild, so external commands may not exist yet
prebuildChecks.pattern: Each check has INLINE bash functions (_update_cpu, _update_gpu, _update_memory) that write hardware-config.nix directly
prebuildChecks.note: update-hardware-config script only exists AFTER nixos-rebuild switch

jqRequirements.commonError: jq: error: formatValue/0 is not defined — use formatValue($x) not $x | formatValue
